Your Right to a Safe Delivery Rainbow Children’s Medicare Limited reports robust Q2 FY27 performance, with 23% revenue growth and continued progress across its network • Revenue grows 23% YoY, with EBITDA and PAT recording double-digit growth • Nellore and Guntur hospitals commence operations, strengthening Rainbow’s Andhra Pradesh network • Growth initiatives gain traction across pediatric, fertility, and maternity services Hyderabad, October 31, 2026: Rainbow Children’s Medicare Limited (RCML), India’s leading pediatric and perinatal healthcare network, today announced its results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting 23% year-on-year revenue growth, supported by healthy patient volume, improving performance across hospitals and continued progress in its operational and digital initiatives. Revenue grew by 23% year-on-year during the quarter, while EBITDA and Profit After Tax (PAT) recorded growth of 14% and 11%, respectively. Inpatient and outpatient volumes remained healthy despite seasonal softness due to significant monsoon shortfall. Rainbow’s growth initiatives through digital and community connect are beginning to translate into stronger patient engagement and business ramp-up, translating into higher OPD footfalls and inpatient admissions. Rainbow has further strengthened its presence in Coastal Andhra with the commencement of operations at its newly acquired 70-bed hospital in Nellore and 50-bed brand new hospital in Guntur. These additions extend Rainbow’s network from Visakhapatnam to Chennai. The company plans to further expand its presence in the new capital city of Amaravati, in Andhra Pradesh to establish specialty pediatric hospital in a phased manner with an initial bed capacity of 150 beds, following the allotment of two acres of land by the Government of Andhra Pradesh. With the appointment of a new Group CFO, Mr. Sudarshan Patodia, Rainbow has further strengthened its leadership team and organizational capabilities in the growth phase. Q2 & H1FY27 Financial Highlights Particulars (Rs. Cr) Q2FY27 Q2FY26 YoY H1FY27 H1FY26 YoY FY26 Net Revenue from Operations 183.1 154.4 18.6% 352.8 303.7 16.2% 634.2 EBITDA 22.8 29.9 -23.7% 42.3 60.2 -29.6% 122.2 EBITDA Margin 12.4% 19.3% 12.0% 19.8% 19.3% Profit After Tax 14.7 20.6 -28.5% 27.0 40.9 -33.8% 82.7 Profit After Tax Margin 8.1% 13.4% 7.7% 13.5% 13.0% From Managing Director’s Desk – Sidhartha Bhushan Khurana “The first half of the year was marked by a challenging raw material environment. Ongoing geopolitical developments led to sharp volatility in crude oil prices, which in turn drove a steep rise in styrene-based input costs and weighed on our profitability. We have taken calibrated price increases to partly offset this impact; however, a sustained recovery in margins will depend on raw material prices stabilising. In the meantime, we remain focused on what is within our control: improving realisations, driving cost efficiencies and sharpening operational performance. Despite these headwinds, demand remained robust. Revenue from operations grew 16.2% yoy in H1FY27, driven by strong traction in both domestic and international markets, a clear reflection of the strength of our brand and the trust riders place in our products. We continue to build the foundations for our next phase of growth. Our new manufacturing facility has commenced commercial production, added 1.5 million units of annual capacity and giving us significant headroom to meet rising demand at home and overseas. In Europe, we are developing our wholly owned Italian subsidiary into a warehousing and distribution hub to bring us closer to customers across the region. We are also expanding beyond helmets into riding jackets and Bluetooth-enabled rider communication systems, extending our relevance across the riding experience. Our presence at marquee industry platforms such as EICMA in Milan (Italy) and India Bike Week in Panchgani (Maharashtra) further strengthens our brand visibility and deepens our connection with riders and partners in India and around the world. Approval of Unaudited Financial Results The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026, as reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee, together with the Limited Review Reports issued by M/s. Kishor Gujar & Associates, Chartered Accountants, Statutory Auditors of the Company (Firm Registration No. 116747W). The Financial Results and Limited Review Reports are enclosed as Annexure A. 2. Review of Business Performance and Order Book The Board reviewed the operational and financial performance of the Company for the half year ended 30th September 2026 and noted the growth achieved despite continued volatility in raw material prices. The Board noted with satisfaction that the Company's consolidated order book has surpassed ₹2,000 crore, driven by sustained demand for reactors, instrument transformers, Power Conversion Systems (PCS) and FACTS solutions. The Board also reviewed the enquiry pipeline, execution schedules and capacity readiness across the Group's manufacturing operations. The Board further acknowledged the combined efforts of the sales teams of Quality Power and Winwin Speciality Insulators Limited (WSIL) in securing an 800 kV HVDC porcelain insulator order, along with multiple orders for 765 kV and 400 kV applications. These orders have not been included in the Company's reported consolidated order book, pending completion of the proposed acquisition. The Board also commended the technical and manufacturing teams of WSIL for successfully completing the applicable type tests in accordance with European and American standards for porcelain insulators up to 400 kV during the preceding two months. These developments strengthen the commercial and technical positioning of the proposed insulator business in domestic and international markets. 3. Capital Expenditure and Manufacturing Expansion Global Coil Factory, Sangli The Board took note of the commencement of manufacturing operations at the Company's new Global Coil Factory in Sangli on 20th October 2026. The Board further approved an additional capital expenditure of ₹25 crore for establishing manufacturing capabilities for oil filled shunt reactors at the Global Coil Factory. This investment will extend the Company's manufacturing portfolio and address additional opportunities in the high voltage transmission equipment market. HVDC CTC Magnet Wire Facility The Board reviewed the implementation status of the HVDC CTC Magnet Wire manufacturing facility, including machinery readiness and the remaining installation and commissioning activities. Re: Intimation under Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III, and other applicable provisions of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015, as amended. This is further to (i) our letter dated August 08, 2026 informing the outcome of the meeting of our Board of Directors ("Board") approving the Buyback and (ii) our letter dated August 11, 2026 regarding publication of the Public Announcement dated August 10, 2026 for the Buyback. Pursuant to the resolution passed by the Board on August 08, 2026, the Company approved the Buyback of Company’s fully paid-up Equity Shares, at a buyback price not exceeding ₹ 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) per Equity Share (“Maximum Buyback Price”) from the shareholders/ beneficial owners of the Company (other than those who are Promoters, members of the Promoter Group and persons in control of the Company) (“Eligible Shareholders”) excluding Transaction Costs payable in cash for an aggregate amount not exceeding ₹ 697,000,000 (Rupees Six Hundred and Ninety Seven Million only) (hereinafter referred to as the “Maximum Buyback Size”), being 9.99% and 5.09% of the aggregate of the total paid-up Equity Share capital and free reserves of the Company based on the latest standalone and consolidated audited financial statements of the Company respectively, as at March 31, 2026 and which is not more than 10% of the total paid-up Equity Share capital and free reserves of the Company, whichever sets out a lower amount, in accordance with the proviso to Regulation 5(i)(b) of the Buyback Regulations and in accordance with the provisions contained in the Buyback Regulations and the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Buyback”). The Company commenced the Buyback on Friday, August 14, 2026, from the Eligible Shareholders from the Open Market through the Stock Exchanges mechanism under the Buyback Regulations. In this regard, please be informed that as on October 30, 2026, the Company has bought back 2,410,906 (Two Million Four Hundred Ten Thousand Nine Hundred and Six)) Equity Shares at an average price of ₹ 289.09/- (Rupees Two Hundred and Eighty Nine and Nine Paisa only) per Equity Share and utilized ₹ 696,962,962.22 (Rupees Six Hundred Ninety-Six Million Nine Hundred Sixty-Two Thousand Nine Hundred Sixty-Two and Twenty-Two Paise), which is 99.99% of the Maximum Buyback Size (excluding Transaction Costs). corporate_announcements.pdf_extracted_text: Date: October 30, 2026 To, To, Department of Corporate Services Listing Department BSE Limited National Stock Exchange of India Ltd Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, Exchange Plaza, Plot No. C/1, G Block, Bandra Dalal Street, Kurla Complex, Bandra (East), Mumbai – Mumbai - 400001 400051 Scrip Code: 543528 ISIN- INE0JA001018 Symbol: VENUSPIPES Sub: Press /Media Release Dear Sir/Madam, Please find enclosed herewith a copy of the press/media release being issued by the Company for your information and record. Thanking you, Yours faithfully, For Venus Pipes & Tubes Limited CS Pavan Kumar Jain Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Membership No. A66752 Venus Pipes & Tubes Limited A Key Milestone in Pipe Spooling Business Venus Pipes & Tubes receives Rs. 29 Crore Order Against Rs. 185 Crore LOI from Data Centre Customer for Pipe Spooling solutions Dhaneti, Gujarat – 30th October 2026 : Venus Pipes & Tubes Ltd, one of the leading stainless- steel pipes / tubes manufacturers and exporters along with fittings in India announces today the receipt of order worth Rs. 29 crore for pipe spooling from a data centre customer, forming part of the Rs. 185 crore Letter of Intent (LOI) received earlier. The order follows the commencement of operations at a part of the Company’s dedicated pipe spooling manufacturing facility, which was commissioned ahead of the earlier planned timeline of December 2026. With production already underway, the Company is positioned to initiate execution and facilitate faster dispatch against the order. The balance value under the LOI is expected to be converted into firm orders in a phased manner. The Company plans to operationalise the remaining manufacturing capacity over the next few months to support the anticipated business. With increasing demand for end to end piping solutions, Company’s expansion into pipe spooling represents an opportunity to broaden its value-added product portfolio and strengthen its participation in emerging industrial segments. Commenting on the same, Arun Kothari, Managing Director, Venus Pipes & Tubes Ltd, said, “The conversion of the LOI into a firm order marks an important step in translating the identified opportunity into business. We believe this order reflects the customer’s confidence in our capabilities and the growing demand for value-added piping solutions in the data centre infrastructure segment. We are encouraged by the opportunity and expect the balance value under the LOI to be converted into orders in a phased manner. Our pipe spooling capabilities will enable us to expand our value-added product portfolio, cater to evolving customer requirements and strengthen our presence across emerging industrial segments.” About Venus Pipes & Tubes Ltd (https://www.venuspipes.com/; BSE: 543528; NSE: VENUSPIPES) Venus Pipes & Tubes Limited is a manufacturer and exporter of stainless-steel pipes and tubes. The company is into manufacturing of stainless steel tubes / pipes products along with fittings. Company manufactures pipes / tubes in two broad categories - seamless tubes/pipes and welded tubes/pipes under which five categories of products are manufactured namely, stainless steel high precision & heat exchanger tubes, stainless steel hydraulic & instrumentation tubes, stainless steel seamless pipes, stainless steel welded pipes and stainless-steel LSAW pipes. The company sells products in both domestic and international markets. Venus Pipes & Tubes exports its products to more than 30 countrie

No.: A39220 Encl: as above Registered Office: E-69, EPIP, Sitapura Industrial Area, Jaipur-302022, Rajasthan, India • Phone: +91-141-2770648; +91-141-2771975 CIN: L36911RJ1989PLC004945 • Email: investor_relations@vaibhavglobal.com • Website: www.vaibhavglobal.com PRESS RELEASE VGL Completes Platform Transition, Focuses on Restoring Digital Momentum and Improving Operating Leverage JAIPUR, India, 28 October 2026 -- Vaibhav Global Limited ("VGL") (NSE: VAIBHAVGBL; BSE: 532156), a vertically integrated electronic retailer of fashion jewellery, accessories and lifestyle products, today reported results for the second quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. Mr. Sunil Agarwal, Managing Director, Vaibhav Global Limited, said:" Q2 FY27 was a quarter of transition as we completed the migration of our channel websites from Salesforce Commerce Cloud to Shopify Enterprise. During the stabilisation phase, temporary integration-related challenges, including customer account reactivation, optimisation of search and merchandising functionality, and SEO re-indexing, impacted digital conversion and revenue. In the UK, we also consolidated four warehouses and two studios into a single, larger headquarters. While the transition was completed smoothly, some inventory remains temporarily offline, limiting product availability and customer choice. Despite these near-term challenges, our European business delivered growth in constant currency, our B2B business recorded strong growth, and total revenue for the first half grew close to 10%. With the transition substantially behind us, we now have a unified, cloud-based and scalable platform supporting our brands and geographies. Our focus is on restoring digital momentum, strengthening customer acquisition and improving operating leverage as we enter our seasonally strongest quarters. We believe the new platform provides a stronger foundation for accelerating digital growth and driving sustainable, profitable growth in the periods ahead.,” • Revenue Growth: Revenue from operations increased 7.0% to ₹938.4 crore in Q2 FY27.
